Observed PostgreSQL HBA contains local/loopback trust and remote SCRAM, not GSS authentication. PostgreSQL GSS transport negotiation can occur before SQL authentication: SCRAM HBA does not prove GSS transport disabled, and the residual boundary includes unauthenticated direct database-protocol peers without stolen SQL credentials.
